Messages.Author: Petri Wessman
Messages.Body:
Small question: does Shade do damage when the combat is at long range?
The card text is:

When the minion with this retainer is in combat, the
opposing minion takes 1 damage during strike
resolution.

Which would seem to imply that range doesn't matter, but on the other
hands Murder of Crows specifically mentions ranged damage. Hmmm....

//Petri

Messages.Author: LSJ (VtES Rep)
Messages.Body:


The damage doesn't apply if the combat is at long range.
This is standard for all damage-dealing retainers (unless the
retainer does 'R' damage).
